workExperiences.description: I joined the Applied research and innovation team, where I worked on various internal projects related to experimental chemistry. My role involved developing software solutions to support research activities and collaborating with scientists. Main software engineering tasks included designing and implementing applications, optimizing existing codebases and DevOps.

I joined the company at the start of the Data Lake integration and worked closely with the main Data Engineer. I created and managed data pipelines using ADF, wrote custom Python scripts that were run on Azure Batch service, and prepared custom export solutions in XSLT for the Fidoo app. My biggest achievement was implementing a custom logging solution, which included everything from the logging library to the final Power BI report, providing crucial insights into our script runs.

It was my responsibility to monitor, review, and respond to security alerts and incidents, ensuring the timely identification of potential threats, analyzing suspicious activities, and implementing appropriate remediation measures to safeguard the organization's network and data.

education.description: A two-year master’s programme specializing in Software Technologies. Focuses on software engineering, biomedical image processing, bioinformatics, and the analysis of biomedical data using machine learning and artificial intelligence.

A 3.5-year degree with a strong emphasis on practical application over theory, highlighted by a mandatory internship in the final semester. One-third of the courses are taught in English. The curriculum focuses on foundational statistics, machine learning methods, and various data-related disciplines

Learned a bit of everything ranging from databases, networks, operating systems, and programming. This gave me a great base knowledge, which I used to further develop my skills. Mostly took interest in programming. Graduated with straight A's.

projects.description: A molecule renderer built from scratch in C and raylib. It reads XYZ coordinates, colors atoms by element, infers bonds from covalent radii, and supports keyboard-controlled camera orbiting.
Detects people in ČVUT cafeteria camera images using YOLOv5-CrowdHuman. A lightweight IoU tracker maintains person IDs across video frames, with configurable detection and tracking thresholds.

A single perceptron implemented from scratch in C, demonstrated by learning the AND function. Includes feedforward evaluation, configurable activation, weight and bias updates, and manual memory management.

An email organizer that classifies IMAP messages using a locally running Ollama model. CLI and terminal interfaces support reviewing and approving folder, archive, and trash actions, with local history and optional encryption.

My bachelor’s thesis: a Python implementation of UTA algorithms for multi-criteria decision analysis. It learns additive utility functions from preference rankings, with a scikit-learn-compatible solver and a Streamlit interface.
Finds book recommendations from a natural-language description. A Python backend combines embeddings, cosine similarity, FAISS search, and cross-encoder reranking, with a Streamlit interface.

A full-stack reservation system built with PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap. Includes interactive seat selection, timed reservations to prevent double booking, role-based administration, checkout, and emailed QR e-tickets.
A bookstore inventory REST API built as an interview project using Java and Spring Boot. Supports CRUD operations and JWT access control, with PostgreSQL and Docker.
A searchable Star Wars encyclopedia built with React, TypeScript, and Material UI. A project exploring API integration and responsive interfaces.

Built with colleagues during an extracurricular course at EY to estimate car crash costs from user inputs. Uses Chicago crash data, an Anvil web interface, and binary classification approaches including neural networks, linear regression, and random forests.

Explores four approaches to the 0–1 knapsack problem in C#: brute force, parallel brute force, dynamic programming, and distributed computation. Compares how the same problem can be approached through different execution models.

A C# command-line tool that converts images and videos, including YouTube inputs, into ASCII art. Supports console, text, PNG, and HTML output; built as a high-school project and stored using Git LFS.
